name: if-it-fits
description: A no-fail soft-body puzzle where you nudge squishy cats into teacups, boxes, boots and sinks.

scripts.build:single: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode single && node scripts/inline.mjs dist-single
scripts.build:protos: npm run typecheck && PAGE=jar vite build --mode single && node scripts/inline.mjs dist-proto/jar jar && PAGE=drop vite build --mode single && node scripts/inline.mjs dist-proto/drop drop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && vite build
